representative.title: PCR Protocol for Phusion High-Fidelity DNA Polymerase (M0530)
representative.assay: DNA amplification for genotyping, cloning, or amplicon generation
representative.operation: Amplify a purified DNA template with a conventional thermocycler and high-fidelity polymerase
representative.specimen: Purified DNA template, including genomic, plasmid, or viral DNA
representative.methodVariant: Phusion high-fidelity DNA polymerase; endpoint amplification
representative.evidenceStatus: metadata-verified; license-verified; endpoint readout is not detailed on the record
representative.selectionNote: Direct New England Biolabs protocol record with DOI, update metadata, routine PCR scope, and an explicit record-level Creative Commons Attribution statement. It is a strong general conventional-PCR representative and is distinct from qPCR, RT-PCR, digital PCR, and long-range PCR.

screened.title: PCR Protocol for Taq DNA Polymerase with ThermoPol Buffer
screened.reason: Authoritative New England Biolabs routine-PCR alternative using standard Taq chemistry; retained as a polymerase-chemistry variant while Phusion is the stronger general high-fidelity representative.

screened.title: Environmental DNA metabarcoding of COI gene using endpoint PCR
screened.reason: Complete endpoint PCR and agarose-gel readout, but environmental COI-specific and multiplex-kit focused rather than a general conventional-PCR workflow.

representative.title: Gene expression analysis by quantitative Real-Time PCR (qPCR)
representative.assay: Quantitative gene-expression amplification with TaqMan or SYBR fluorescence readout
representative.operation: Prepare TaqMan or SYBR qPCR reactions, run them on a real-time thermal cycler, and analyze threshold-cycle values by the delta-delta Ct method
representative.methodVariant: TaqMan and SYBR qPCR options with delta-delta Ct gene-expression analysis
representative.evidenceStatus: metadata-verified; license-verified; dual chemistry is covered but the record is gene-expression and LightCycler-specific
representative.selectionNote: Direct protocols.io record with explicit record-level Creative Commons Attribution evidence and two stated qPCR options: TaqMan and SYBR. It is a stronger chemistry-coverage representative than the earlier dye-only record, but remains tied to cDNA gene expression and a Roche LightCycler 480 platform.

screened.title: qPCR (Bio-Rad)
screened.reason: SYBR qPCR workflow on a Bio-Rad iQ5 platform; useful instrument-platform alternative but narrower and less general than the Promega representative.

screened.title: TaqMan qPCR assay for detecting Batrachochytrium dendrobatidis
screened.reason: Direct DNA qPCR using hydrolysis-probe chemistry on a Bio-Rad CFX96; retained as the major TaqMan chemistry variant, but organism-specific and narrower than the representative.

screened.title: Quantitative RT-PCR Using TaqMan Gene Expression Assays
screened.reason: TaqMan RT-qPCR gene-expression workflow on an Applied Biosystems StepOnePlus platform; documents probe and platform variants but is cDNA/gene-expression focused.

screened.title: Introduction to TaqMan and SYBR Green Chemistries for Real-Time PCR
screened.reason: Authoritative Thermo Fisher guide covering both TaqMan and SYBR chemistry, but retained as a metadata-only alternative because no record-level reuse statement was verified.

coverageGaps: The representative covers both TaqMan and SYBR chemistry but is tied to cDNA gene-expression assays; a general DNA copy-number or plasmid-template qPCR representative is still missing.
Instrument-specific validation beyond the Roche LightCycler 480 workflow is represented only by screened alternatives.
nextSearchSuggestions: Search protocols.io and Thermo Fisher Scientific for a general non-RT TaqMan qPCR protocol spanning copy-number or plasmid-DNA quantification on multiple real-time platforms.
Search Bio-protocol for a platform-neutral qPCR SOP that supports both cDNA gene expression and direct DNA copy-number measurements.

representative.title: RNA Extraction and RT-PCR on Mouse Tissues
representative.operation: Extract RNA, synthesize cDNA, amplify cDNA by endpoint PCR, and verify amplicon size by agarose gel
representative.specimen: Mouse heart and skeletal muscle tissue
representative.methodVariant: Two-step cDNA synthesis followed by standard Taq endpoint PCR
representative.evidenceStatus: metadata-verified; license-verified; representative is mouse-tissue and two-step specific
representative.selectionNote: Most complete direct record found for endpoint RT-PCR, including RNA extraction, cDNA synthesis, endpoint amplification, and gel verification. It is intentionally kept separate from RT-qPCR; one-step RT-PCR, non-mammalian templates, and broader specimen coverage remain open variants.

screened.title: Tiled PCR Amplification for Poliovirus Whole-Genome Sequencing
screened.reason: One-step RT-PCR with post-amplification gel verification and a direct CC BY record, but tiled poliovirus whole-genome sequencing is pathogen- and amplicon-design-specific rather than a general transcript-detection workflow.

screened.title: First-Strand cDNA Synthesis and Conventional PCR
screened.reason: Two-step cDNA synthesis plus conventional PCR for yellow fever virus RNA; strong endpoint RT-PCR alternative but older and pathogen-specific.

screened.title: LN34 Pan-lyssavirus Real-time RT-PCR Assay
screened.reason: One-step real-time TaqMan RT-PCR with qPCR Cq readout and lyssavirus safety context; not endpoint RT-PCR.

screened.title: SOP: cDNA Synthesis by RT Promega Kit
screened.reason: Useful reverse-transcription record but cDNA-synthesis-only; it lacks downstream endpoint PCR and transcript readout.

coverageGaps: The representative covers two-step endpoint RT-PCR on mouse tissue but not a general RNA-template workflow across organisms or specimen types.
One-step endpoint RT-PCR remains without a qualified representative; the screened one-step record is real-time TaqMan and therefore a wrong readout variant.
nextSearchSuggestions: Search protocols.io and Bio-protocol for a platform-neutral one-step endpoint RT-PCR protocol with agarose-gel readout and no qPCR quantification.
Search Thermo Fisher Scientific and New England Biolabs for a general RNA-to-cDNA plus endpoint-PCR protocol not tied to mouse tissue or a pathogen.

selfCheckNotes: Category results are present exactly once and remain in the assigned packet order.
All representative and screened sourceUrl values are stable HTTP(S) DOI landing URLs.
All representatives have direct record-level Creative Commons Attribution evidence; no license pass was inferred from public readability alone.
qPCR and RT-PCR are partial because major chemistry, platform, specimen, or workflow variants remain explicitly uncovered.
No missing-value placeholders or mixed source labels were written.

runNotes: Search scope covered direct protocols.io records plus Bio-protocol, Thermo Fisher Scientific, New England Biolabs, and Promega source families.
Only metadata, identifiers, short evidence notes, and coverage decisions were stored; protocol steps and source passages were not copied.
